verdicts.reason: A shrinks the NEW FLAVOR badge until it can't be read and leaves it stranded below the CTA, which breaks the reading order. The headline also wraps awkwardly ('Chase the / Light'), and the oversized CTA nearly crowds the right edge. B keeps the badge readable and the headline on one line, and it reads cleanly left to right: copy on the left, can and logo on the right. B's problems: the CTA is too big and sits almost on the left edge, the body copy nearly touches that edge too, and the headline looks weak next to the oversized button.
